# Optimity Technologies — AI that takes the routine work off your team

> Optimity Technologies is an AI product company that also builds custom AI systems. Concierge AI answers calls and books appointments, with editions for movers (Move Concierge AI™), home-service trades (Trade Concierge AI) and nail and hair salons (Salon Concierge AI). Property Connect AI™ can call eligible real-estate web leads back within 60 seconds when they come through connected forms and sources. Nexus AI™ answers plain-English questions across ERPNext, HubSpot, PostgreSQL and supported document sources.

Optimity is a team of senior engineers and architects in India, the USA and the UAE. When a person needs to follow up, Concierge AI sends the details to the business's team; Property Connect AI briefs an agent privately before joining a serious buyer to the call; Nexus AI only makes a change in a connected system after that action has been turned on and approved, and only for people whose role allows it.

## Products

- [Concierge AI](https://optimitytechnologies.com/concierge-ai.html): an AI receptionist that answers every call, day or night, books and reschedules appointments in Google Calendar, and shows every call and booking in a dashboard. When a person needs to follow up, such as on a question about price, it sends the details to the team. Other booking systems are custom integrations Optimity can scope and build. Editions:
  - [Move Concierge AI™](https://optimitytechnologies.com/move-concierge.html): the movers edition. Answers the calls routed to it (after hours, on weekends, when every line is busy); asks about the move (date, origin and destination, home size, stairs and elevator access, large or fragile items); writes up the lead in the dashboard; books a virtual or in-home estimate in the estimators' Google Calendar; and sends the details to the team when a person needs to follow up. Moving software or CRM connections are custom integrations Optimity can scope and build.
  - [Trade Concierge AI](https://optimitytechnologies.com/trade-concierge.html): the AI receptionist for plumbers and home-service trades (electricians, HVAC techs, handymen). Books jobs into Google Calendar and sends the details to the team when a caller needs a person. It isn't a substitute for 911.
  - [Salon Concierge AI](https://optimitytechnologies.com/salon-concierge.html): the AI receptionist for nail and hair salons, beauty studios and barbers. Books and moves appointments in Google Calendar and sends questions about price to the team.
- [Property Connect AI™](https://optimitytechnologies.com/property-connect.html): voice AI for real-estate teams. Can call eligible leads back within 60 seconds when they come through connected forms and sources; checks budget, pre-approval and timeline; books the tour with an SMS invite to the buyer; and hands serious buyers to an agent after a short private briefing. Offers, negotiation and anything outside the agreed questions stay with agents. CRM and calendar connections are custom work Optimity can scope and build.
- [Nexus AI™](https://optimitytechnologies.com/nexus-ai.html): plain-English questions across ERPNext, HubSpot, PostgreSQL and supported document sources. Nexus AI can cite supporting documents; source traceability for ERP, CRM and database answers varies by connector and query. Three engines (SmartOps AI™, DocIntellect AI™, SQL Database Agent). Read-only database access for queries, Clerk enterprise authentication and isolated database partitions, team-level and row-level permissions, deployment on customer-managed infrastructure with self-hosted inference available, and write actions only when turned on, approved and allowed by the person's role.
- [All products](https://optimitytechnologies.com/products.html): short overview of Concierge AI, Property Connect AI and Nexus AI.

## Custom AI systems

- [Custom AI Systems](https://optimitytechnologies.com/custom-ai-systems.html): focused workflows, agents, integrations and interfaces for operational needs the products don't cover, built around the systems a business already runs, with each connection agreed before work starts. Delivery: discover the workflow, configure, integrate, launch.
